promoted: Speculative-safe C4 tail ring (VLLM_GLM53_KPOOL_TAIL_RING default 1) with the head-gate switch present and off (VLLM_GLM53_INDEXER_GATE_TC default 0), exactly as the E31 overlay was measured.
method: No restart: the running service already is the measured overlay; the default encodes it with four-rank launcher parity.
sparkcache_namespace: Kept (warm cache kept, no restart). Residual risk: pools built by speculative decode with the legacy four-slot tail could be restored for resumed sessions; it is not established that decode-built pools are persisted. The external review concurred that this is not a confirmed blocker.
head_gate: unresolved; stays off. Arm G versus arm R is inconclusive because changing the gate changed generated tokens and therefore draft acceptance.
rigmark_policy: From 2026-09-28: upstream unmodified Rigmark (alexellis/rigmark c5a0db0) with exactly the reference flags of Alex Ellis's GLM receipts: all defaults plus --extra-body '{"chat_template_kwargs": {"reasoning_effort": "low"}}', no cache_salt, a fresh comparison ID per suite. Quick screens may use one suite per arm on the same load. Frozen E29-and-earlier records used 8,192 decode tokens, thinking off and a local fork forwarding cache_salt to prefill requests; they are historical and not comparable with the new flags.
